short.text: Daniel Te'o-Nesheim is a veteran end who signed with Jacksonville as a free agent from Tampa Bay in March 2014 and has dressed for {{2014.regular.games:words}} games, opening the season as a reserve. He is a power end suited to a defined job setting the edge and keeping contain against the run. He has more value there than as a speed rusher, because his get-off, bend and counter moves are his main weaknesses.

transactions.text: Signed a three-year contract with Jacksonville (2014 to 2016)
